description: Key facts a correct lesson on each Object-Oriented Programming topic must state. Every fact was taken from the fetched text of the source page named with it (the quote is checked by `npm run golden:check`). Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions matched against the lesson text after LaTeX backslashes and braces are removed.
subject: oop

facts.claim: An ADT is defined by its behaviour/operations, not its implementation

source.quote: defined by its behavior (semantics) from the point of view of a user of the data

facts.claim: e.g. a stack (push/pop) implemented by an array or a linked list

source.quote: can be concretely implemented using either a linked list or an array

facts.claim: A class is a blueprint for objects

source.quote: is a syntactic structure, or blueprint, of all objects of a specific type

facts.claim: State (variables) and behaviour (methods)

source.quote: state (variables) and behavior (methods)

facts.claim: Bundling data with the methods that operate on it

source.quote: the bundling of data with the mechanisms or methods that operate on the data

facts.claim: Restricting direct access to an object's data

source.quote: the limiting of direct access to some of that data

facts.claim: A subclass inherits from a superclass (base class)

source.quote: An inherited class is called a subclass of its parent class or super class

facts.claim: Inheritance lets you reuse code

source.quote: to reuse code

facts.claim: One function or interface works with values of different types

source.quote: A function that can evaluate to or be applied to values of different types is known as a polymorphic function

facts.claim: Ad hoc polymorphism (overloading)

source.quote: Christopher Strachey chose the term ad hoc polymorphism

facts.claim: An abstract class cannot be instantiated

source.quote: cannot be instantiated directly

facts.claim: It is used through concrete subclasses

source.quote: Instantiation of an abstract type can occur only indirectly, via a concrete subtype

facts.claim: Types specified later as type parameters

source.quote: algorithms are written in terms of data types to-be-specified-later

facts.claim: An exception breaks normal flow and runs a handler

source.quote: an exception breaks the normal flow of execution and executes a pre-registered exception handler

facts.claim: Garbage collection reclaims memory no longer referenced

source.quote: The garbage collector attempts to reclaim memory that was allocated by the program, but is no longer referenced

facts.claim: It is automatic memory management

source.quote: garbage collection (GC) is a form of automatic memory management

facts.claim: A reusable solution to a common design problem

source.quote: A software design pattern describes a reusable solution to a commonly needed behavior in software

facts.claim: Popularised by the Gang of Four book (1994)

source.quote: after the book Design Patterns: Elements of Reusable Object-Oriented Software was published in 1994

facts.claim: Model, view and controller

source.quote: divides the related program logic into three interconnected elements

facts.claim: View presents information; controller links model and view

source.quote: the view, the interface that presents information to and accepts it from the user

facts.claim: Unit tests check small isolated parts of the code

source.quote: isolated source code is tested to validate expected behavior
